approach.name: Local favourite
approach.description: Warm and neighbourly: hours, address and a call button stay close.

pages.label: Your page
pages.approach: Warm and neighbourly: hours, address and a call button stay close.

sections.label: Top bar
sections.intent: Keeps the business name or logo in view, with short links to services, work, reviews and contact. A clear Call or WhatsApp button sits at the right so any visitor can reach the owner in one tap. It shrinks to the name and a single button on phones.
sections.layout: Single slim row on white with a hairline rule beneath; name left, links centred, accent-coloured call button right; collapses to name plus icon button on mobile

sections.label: Welcome and hours
sections.intent: Says in one bold, plain line what the business does and for whom, with the tagline under it. Right beside it, a small neighbourly card shows today's hours, the area or address and a call button, so a local client knows at once whether they can walk in or ring now. Calls to action lead to getting in
sections.layout: Asymmetric 7/5 grid: large type and two buttons on the wider left, a thin-bordered hours and address card on the narrower right

sections.label: What we do
sections.intent: A quiet running line of the owner's services or specialities, so visitors grasp the range in a glance before reading further. Works for any trade, from tailoring to tax filing.
sections.layout: Edge-to-edge marquee strip between two thin lines, service names in small caps separated by the accent dot

sections.label: Our story
sections.intent: The owner's own words on who they are, how long they have served the neighbourhood and where they work. A real photo of the person, shop or workspace builds trust that this is a local, reachable business.
sections.layout: Two columns: one portrait picture on the left, a short story with the locality named on the right, generous white space around both

sections.label: Services and prices
sections.intent: Lists each service with a one-line description and a starting price where the owner wants to share it, so clients know what to ask for and roughly what it costs before calling.
sections.layout: Heading and a short note pinned on the left, a numbered list with thin dividers between rows on the right

sections.label: Recent work
sections.intent: Shows real examples of the owner's work, one standout piece made large, so visitors can judge quality for themselves. Any profession can fill it with photos of finished jobs, products or happy events.
sections.layout: Bento grid with one large tile and four smaller tiles, hairline gaps, captions on hover

sections.label: Neighbours speak
sections.intent: Short quotes from local clients with their names and areas, next to a few honest numbers like years in business and clients served, so trust comes from the people nearby.
sections.layout: Three equal columns with thin vertical dividers: a stats column flanked by two quote columns

sections.label: Common questions
sections.intent: Answers what clients ask before reaching out: timings, home visits, payment by UPI, how far they travel, and how long jobs take, saving the owner repeat calls.
sections.layout: Centred narrow column with generous space above and below, accordion rows separated by thin lines

sections.label: Get in touch
sections.intent: The one place to reach out: big Call and WhatsApp buttons for those who prefer to talk, and a short enquiry form for those who would rather write, with the address and hours repeated so nothing needs scrolling back.
sections.layout: A band in the brand accent colour with light text and the call and WhatsApp buttons, a white card holding the enquiry form overlapping its lower edge

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: Closes with the name, a warm one-line sign-off, phone, email, address, social links and the year, so contact details stay handy at the very end.
sections.layout: Two-row footer: name and line left with contacts right, then a hairline and a small row of social icons and the year
